note: Residency and eligibility policy per school, keyed by slug (data/school-registry.json). An entry goes in only after its rule was read on the school's own admissions page, and source_url must point there. Anything absent stays 'unknown' in medical_schools, and the app makes no eligibility claim about it. Paraphrase policy_note; do not paste the school's wording.

u-washington.policy_note: A five-state regional school: residents of Washington, Wyoming, Alaska, Montana and Idaho apply into their state's cohort. Out-of-region applicants are considered only with ties to a WWAMI state and a disadvantaged background or a record of serving underserved communities.
u-washington.verified_how: Read through the search index of that page. The page itself refuses automated requests, so open it by hand once to confirm.
